title: Job Record
description: A single scraped job posting. Canonical contract between job-scraper (producer) and downstream consumers. additionalProperties is true, so downstream tools (triage agents, dashboards) may add their own fields.

url.description: Canonical posting URL. Must be http or https scheme. Primary key.

title.description: Job title as scraped from the listing.

ats.description: Source label: LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, ZipRecruiter, GoogleJobs, HiringCafe, CalCareers, CSUCareers, USAJOBS, NEOGOV, CalOpps, Greenhouse, Workday, Priority.

first_seen.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp added by the scraper's merge step when a job first enters all_jobs.json.

location.description: Location string as scraped (e.g. 'San Francisco, CA', 'Remote'). May be empty.

date_posted.description: ISO date or relative string (e.g. '2026-08-14', '3 days ago'). Format varies by source.

salary.description: Raw salary/pay string as scraped. May be empty string.

description.description: Job description text. Truncated to source-specific max (LinkedIn: 12000 chars; JobSpy boards: 6000 chars). Absent for government board sources.

direct_url.description: Direct apply URL, when different from url.

is_remote.description: Remote signal. true if remote, false if on-site, absent if unknown.

telework.description: Board-specific telework label (e.g. 'Telecommute eligible'). Used by government boards.

work_arrangement.description: Normalized work mode derived from is_remote, telework, job_type, and location text. Empty string when undetermined.

salary_source.description: Where the salary was extracted from (e.g. 'Indeed', 'LinkedIn').

emails.description: Contact email(s) from the listing. Comma-separated if multiple.

duplicate_urls.description: Alternate URLs for the same job, accumulated during cross-source duplicate merge.
